reviews.rationale: The paper substantively perturbs hepatic Cdo1 (KO/OE) but assigns it a Camkk2-AMPK-FAO signaling role in NAFLD, not the taurine-mediated bile-acid conjugation function of this mechanism, and reports hepatic taurine was unchanged after knockout (attributed to extrahepatic compensation). reviews.rationale: In vivo Sult2a8-haplodeficient mice causally show reduced 7α-OH bile-acid sulfonation and altered bile-acid/cholesterol handling, supporting the assigned function. The mouse liver setting is under fasting rather than aging/MASLD, making the declared direct context overclaimed.
